choice.basis: The dashboard explicitly labels the feedback share for each category with a percentage inscription above its marker. The lowest of these printed values is 18%, which is assigned to Service Delivery. The O/B checks confirm that the percentage inscriptions are the authoritative source for the 'feedback share' metric (r1 supported), while the vertical marker positions (r2) are refuted as the source of the share value because they contradict the explicit data labels. Therefore, Service Delivery is the lowest-share category and must be routed to the low-feedback coverage follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Route Service Delivery to low-feedback coverage follow-up
